title: Copy File Contents
question: Copy text from one temporary file to another.
code:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    src, dst = Path(folder) / 'a.txt', Path(folder) / 'b.txt'
    src.write_text('sample', encoding='utf-8')
    dst.write_text(src.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), encoding='utf-8')
    print(dst.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
explanation: Path read_text() and write_text() simplify small text-file operations.
